name: nasaq
description: Organize and rename work files consistently
author: Nasaq

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json -w" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron . --no-sandbox"
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:web
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:python-engine
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:all && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:win:publish: npm run build:all && electron-builder --win --publish always --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:all && electron-builder --linux dir --config electron-builder.json
